dogecoin.text: @StevieJarosz @VijarKohli @sairarahman And in addition, Bitcoin isn't just the technology.  Litecoin, BCash, BSV, Dogecoin, etc are near clones of Bitcoin with only minor modifications and yet are tiny by comparison.  This is because Bitcoin is also the network itself, not just the technology that implements it.

@inevitable360 The whole thing was recorded for anyone to check.  I challenge you to find where I called you (or anyone involved in Dogecoin or any other altcoin) a "shitcoiner".
The only time the word came out of my mouth was when I was pointing out that I *don't* hold that position.

@OneGoodShibe @jimjimmiejames Thanks. And don't worry, I don't judge the Dogecoin community based on that guy.
While I don't have any interest in Dogecoin personally, I believe strongly in actual freedom (unlike a lot of "Maxis") and wish you all well with what you're building (both technically and socially).
